$description: GENERATED by harness/cli/known.mts from the command registry (harness/cli/commands/*.mts) and harness/cli/planned-commands.json. Do not edit: add a command module, or a planned entry. Every `sketchbook` command and `--start` starter the Claude layer (.claude/) may name; harness/test/claude-layer.test.mts rejects any other (SB-0038). `planned: true` means not in the registry yet, so docs say `sketchbook help <cmd>` to confirm options.

init.summary: In a new or empty folder: install the whole harness (engine, Claude layer, hooks, configs, starter content), check it, then explain what was installed. In a project: pick a starting point (--start) and/or set the brand, regenerate, then check.

status.summary: Show the prefix, brand summary, components by status, overrides and design sync state (read-only).

doctor.summary: Health report (read-only): starter, harness version, installed vs catalog components, kits, brands, overrides, design sync, failing checks, the Claude layer (installed or staged) and the commit gate. Exits like check (0 pass, 1 a check fails, 2 pass with overrides).

upgrade.summary: Update harness-owned files. In a project that runs the engine from node_modules: from the installed engine (after npm update), no --from. Elsewhere: from a newer Sketchbook folder or git URL (harness-owned in both manifests); team-owned, shared, reclassified and protected files (the manifest itself, configs, package files) are listed, never touched; writing anything needs --yes (a dry run first shows what).

propagate.summary: Carry a Foundations or harness change to every output: rebuild the tokens and components, build the engine, sync the design file scripts (tokens and foundations), and record what the outputs were built from. --maintainer also builds Storybook and the docs site (maintainers only).

generate.summary: Rebuild every generated output from the spec: token CSS, component tokens, component styles, the barrel, brand CSS and the token interface (what npm run generate runs in a project).

prefix.summary: Rename the element and CSS prefix everywhere (sources, contracts, tests, docs), rebuild, then check.

swap.summary: Replace an adapter (token build or design tool) without touching the spec, then rebuild and check.

add.summary: Install a component from the catalog (contract, code, stories, specs; dependencies first), or --blank to scaffold a new contract (status draft, proposed decision).

remove.summary: Uninstall a component: refuses while another component or a kit needs it, and without --yes when it is team-made or customized; else removes its files, sets the registry to planned and rebuilds.

list.summary: List catalog components (installed or available) with what each needs, plus template kits (read-only).

kits.summary: Template kits (harness/kits/index.json): list them, add one (its components come from the catalog first) or remove one (--yes when it was edited).

tokens.summary: Change foundations and semantic tokens through the harness: set, preset, presets, diff, impact, add, remove, rename, import, scratch, overrides.

presets.summary: List the standards catalog: families, or one family's presets with sources (read-only).

brand.summary: Several brands over one semantic interface: brands/<name>.brand.json; add, list, use (copy into brand.config.json and regenerate) and build (tokens.<brand>.css for each).

icons.summary: The icons the system uses (spec/icons.json, Lucide): list them, add one or more from Lucide (--category) or remove them. The design adapters draw one component per icon (sketchbook sync icons).

api.summary: The API vocabulary (spec/api.json): list every component prop, event and state against it (canonical, alias, extension), check that nothing is unregistered, explain one name, show the design-file axes and properties one component gets (figma), or the design-file practices Sketchbook adopted (practices, spec/figma-practices.json).

audit-css.summary: Audit an existing product's CSS: cluster its colors (OKLCH distance), font sizes, spacing, radii and shadows into a foundations proposal (generated/import/codebase.proposal.json).

audit-page.summary: Check a complete HTML page using this design system for a level-one heading and main landmark. This static check is not a full accessibility audit.

audit-decisions.summary: Compare the decision log with a trusted earlier copy or Git revision and report changes to settled entries. This read-only audit does not replace check X1.

sync.summary: Write the Figma MCP (use_figma) scripts for the design file (tokens: variable collections, modes and styles), read the file back ("sync verify", then "--ingest"), record a push or a component stage with "sync stamp", list the progress of the component docs with "sync progress", or write the design realization of each contract from the library read-back with "sync realize".

docs.summary: Show a component's or a pattern's documentation, tool-neutral: the same doc a design file draws (variants and states grids, elements, anatomy, accessibility rules and source, tokens) as text, or its blueprint with --json for any design adapter.

check.summary: Run the deterministic checks (exit 0 pass, 1 fail, 2 pass with flagged overrides).

selftest.summary: Run the harness's own tests against the installed engine: they prove every check can still reject and that the CLI, starters and generators work (what npm run test:harness runs in a project).

explain.summary: Explain a token, CSS variable, component, tag or decision from the spec.

help.summary: List commands, or show one command's arguments, options and examples.
